pages.text:
A new core type in the same vessel. Fill it with Lead-Bismuth Eutectic instead of water: two Lead and two Bismuth ingots smelted together in the Arcforge Furnace make four Lead-Bismuth Ingots, melted in the Arc Melter.
- No moderator: leave out graphite, so the neutrons stay fast.
- Fuel it with 15 to 20% enriched rods or MOX. Thorium Blanket Rods round the edge breed fuel.

It runs hot, at 900 °C and more, at low pressure: the metal never boils. Hot lead-bismuth goes out of the Hot Leg to a Steam Generator, which makes Superheated Steam from it.
Lead-bismuth freezes below 125 °C: keep the core warm.
